metas.name: Modha Rathiri
metas.description: Follows two strangers brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: Kumbalangi Nights
metas.description: Revolves around four brothers who share a love-hate relationship with each other. Their relationship progresses to another level when Saji, Boney, and Franky decide to help Bobby stand by his love.

metas.name: Psycho
metas.description: A secretary on the run for embezzlement takes refuge at a secluded California motel owned by a repressed man and his overbearing mother.

metas.name: Sachin - A Billion Dreams
metas.description: A tale of a small boy with dreams and his journey to becoming the God of Cricket and the most celebrated sportsperson in his country.

metas.name: Sonar Kella
metas.description: A young boy becomes a target for crooks, after he claims to remember his past life and mentions precious jewels in a golden fortress.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: Seven years after burying a dark secret, a cinema owner and his family face a renewed investigation led by a relentless new inspector and a grieving mother. New witnesses and forensic traps threaten to shatter their peaceful life.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: A documentary tribute to the series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company, in line with the 25th anniversary of HBO's original limited series.

metas.name: Khushi
metas.description: While playing matchmaker to a pair of their friends, two young university students begin developing feelings for each other.

metas.name: The Help
metas.description: An aspiring author during the civil rights movement of the 1960s decides to write a book detailing the African American maids' point of view on the white families for which they work, and the hardships they go through on a daily b...

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A young aristocrat falls in love with a poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

metas.name: Gully Boy
metas.description: A coming-of-age story based on the lives of street rappers in Mumbai.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: Ghayal
metas.description: A fiery young boxer's world shatters when his brother is murdered by a ruthless industrialist. Framed for the crime, the wounded fighter breaks free to unleash raw revenge.

metas.name: Water
metas.description: Set in colonial India against Gandhi's rise to power, it's the story of 8-year-old Chuyia, who is widowed and sent to a home to live in penitence; once there, Chuyia's feisty presence deeply affects the lives of the other residents.

metas.name: Star Trek Into Darkness
metas.description: After the crew of the Enterprise find an unstoppable force of terror from within their own organization, Captain Kirk leads a manhunt to a war-zone world to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

metas.name: One Battle After Another
metas.description: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

metas.name: Newton
metas.description: A government clerk on election duty in the conflict ridden jungle of Central India tries his best to conduct free and fair voting despite the apathy of security forces and the looming fear of guerrilla attacks by communist rebels.

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: Corpse Bride
metas.description: When a shy groom practices his wedding vows in the inadvertent presence of a deceased young woman, she rises from the grave assuming he has married her.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: Robber
metas.description: An aristocrat's daughter falls in love with a visiting archaeologist, but he holds a secret that could drive them apart.

metas.name: Doctor
metas.description: When his fiancee's niece is kidnapped, a stoic army doctor and his motley team launch a rescue operation in which they need both wit and their wits.

metas.name: Sarbjit
metas.description: Biopic of Sarabjit Singh, a farmer residing at Bhikiwind, Punjab, near the Indo-Pak border, crossed the border after having a couple of drinks. However, he was mistaken to be an Indian spy and was sentenced with capital punishment.

metas.name: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
metas.description: The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organization's name.

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: Petta
metas.description: A hostel warden becomes the target of a dreaded politician and his gangster son, but little do they realize that it is they who should fear him.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: A retired jailer goes on a manhunt to find his son's killers. But the road leads him to a familiar, albeit a bit darker place. Can he emerge from this complex situation successfully?

metas.name: Enna Vilai
metas.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

metas.name: Janatha Garage
metas.description: An environmental activist comes to Hyderabad to attend a seminar, where an unexpected encounter with a man who runs an organization for the oppressed, changes his purpose in life.

metas.name: Raees
metas.description: Criticizing the prohibition of alcohol and illegal drugs in Gujarat, this film unfolds the story of a cruel and clever bootlegger, whose business is challenged by a tough cop.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: The story of Theranos, a multi-billion dollar tech company, its founder Elizabeth Holmes, the youngest self-made female billionaire, and the massive fraud that collapsed the company.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz
metas.description: A newly married couple's life falls in jeopardy when the wife goes missing under mysterious circumstances.

metas.name: Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenaged daughter.

metas.name: Tumhari Sulu
metas.description: Sulu is an ambitious housewife with a loving husband and a happy family. Things start changing for her when she accidentally lands a job as a radio jockey and her show becomes an instant hit.

metas.name: Dressed to Kill
metas.description: A mysterious blonde woman kills one of the patients of a psychiatrist and then goes after the high-class hooker who witnessed the murder.

metas.name: Civil War
metas.description: In the midst of a U.S. civil war, four reporters make the dangerous trip to the capital to interview the president before he is overthrown.

metas.name: Vettaiyan
metas.description: Ruthless criminal activity is met with force from a maverick police officer with a disregard for the rules as he confronts an outbreak of lawlessness.

metas.name: Singham
metas.description: A truly honest police officer is transferred to a town controlled by a gangster he has humiliated. The gangster believes he can use good power to bring down this officer who made him look foolish and weak.

metas.name: Together
metas.description: Years into their relationship, Tim and Millie find themselves at a crossroads as they move to the country. With tensions already flaring, an encounter with an unnatural force threatens to corrupt their lives, their love and their ...

metas.name: Monster House
metas.description: Three teens discover that their neighbor's house is really a living, breathing, scary monster.
